title: Pair progress percentages with visual progress bars
abstract: For each reported work item, show a numeric completion percentage together with a visual progress bar conveying the same value.

source.reference: Generalized project-management and strict-porting proposal; private drafting text not retained

scope_hints.trigger: reporting progress for a project work item

unresolved: Define handling for unknown progress; do not invent a percentage.
remarks: Proposed atomic rule only. Group membership is non-normative; no processing, task creation, rule publication or application is authorized by intake.
